info.title: Nordic Crypto data API
info.description: Public read-only JSON for Nordic Crypto (https://nordiccrypto.no/). No authentication. News, newsletters, events, sources, academia, the who's who, profiles, images, the rules map, the changelog, the article archive, public talk videos and Nordic exchange prices (market data, not investment advice). Kaupr is a news source only, never a sponsor. The sign-off is The Nordic Crypto team. GitHub Pages sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * so browsers can fetch these files. English text is the default; published translations are inside each object under *_i18n. Site languages: /api/v1/languages.json. IP-country language guess: /api/v1/geo-language.json (the nc_lang cookie wins). Discovery: https://nordiccrypto.no/api/v1/index.json. Human docs: https://nordiccrypto.no/api/.

ios.description: Public TestFlight invite. Not an App Store listing.

social.description: Nordic Crypto brand accounts. telegram is https://t.me/nordiccryptochat. x is https://x.com/xcryptonordic. label and name are English. name_i18n has nn, nb, sv, da, fi and is. Other languages use name.

urls.description: github, substack, telegram and x, plus the API bases.

exchange_symbol.description: The pair id used by the exchange.

last.description: Last price as published, decimal string. Null when the exchange does not publish a last trade.

bid.description: Best bid as published, decimal string.

ask.description: Best ask as published, decimal string.

fetched_at.description: When Nordic Crypto fetched this row, ISO 8601 UTC.

source_url.description: Exchange URL the figure was read from.

volume_base.description: Base-asset volume as published. Null when the exchange omits it. Firi's volume is stored here; that payload does not name a 24-hour window. Not treated as zero when missing.

volume_quote.description: Quote-currency volume as published, window not named. Null when omitted.

volume_base_24h.description: Base-asset volume over the last 24 hours. Set only when the exchange names that window (NBX). Not added to volume_base.

volume_quote_24h.description: Quote-currency volume over the last 24 hours (NBX). The unit is this pair's quote (NOK, SEK, DKK or EUR).

exchange_time.description: Timestamp from the exchange payload, when it sends one.

MarketLogo.description: Present when cryptocurrency-icons (CC0-1.0) includes this asset. Null fields on the parent when it does not. Nordic Crypto does not draw substitutes.

MarketVolume.description: Sums of like volume fields inside one pair. Fields are not mixed. A null sum means nobody published that field.

volume_base.description: Sum of volume_base. Unit: base asset. Window not named.

volume_quote.description: Sum of volume_quote. Unit: quote currency. Window not named.

volume_base_24h.description: Sum of volume_base_24h. Unit: base asset over the last 24 hours.

volume_quote_24h.description: Sum of volume_quote_24h. Unit: quote currency over the last 24 hours.

symbol.description: BASE-QUOTE. One bucket per quote currency.

currency.description: Same as quote. NOK is never combined with EUR, SEK or DKK.

updated_at.description: Newest fetched_at among the contributors, ISO 8601 UTC.

exchange_count.description: How many exchanges quoted this pair.

method.description: mean_last when any last exists, otherwise mean_bid_ask_mid. Null when no price can be formed.

price.description: Equals last, or mid when no last exists.

min.description: Lowest value in the same series as price.

max.description: Highest value in the same series as price.

last.description: Arithmetic mean of published last prices. Null if none.

mid.description: Arithmetic mean of (bid+ask)/2 where both were published. Not blended into last.

vwap.description: Always null. Volume windows are not comparable, so there is no VWAP.

logo_url.description: Absolute GitHub Pages URL of the SVG, or null.

aggregation.description: How last, mid, volume and logos are derived.

skipped.description: Venues checked and left out because they have no public ticker.

aggregated.description: One object per quote currency for this asset.
